import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a boxplot to visualize sleep duration by gender
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', data=data, palette='pastel')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Gender', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a boxplot to visualize sleep duration by gender
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', data=data, palette='pastel')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Gender', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
